title: backlog.py --root DIR writes a run state to the coord store of the cwd's clone, so a fixture check reaches the host's real store
goal: A backlog.py --root DIR command that moves a run state writes that state to the coord store of the clone at DIR, whatever the working directory, so a check that plants a fixture clone leaves the host's store untouched

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");C=os.path.abspath("_tools/coord.py");d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp"))
for n in ("clone","other"):
    (d/n).mkdir();s.run(["git","-C",str(d/n),"init","-q"],check=True)
r=d/"clone";(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
(r/"items"/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(id="ST-aaaaaaaa",kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]),indent=2)+"\n")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");[env.pop(k,None) for k in ("KB_COORD_STORE","CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")]
s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),"claim","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by","claude-chk"],cwd=d/"other",env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)  # run from another clone, as a host session may
has=lambda n:"run/ST-aaaaaaaa" in s.run([sys.executable,C,"--store",str(d/n/".git/kb-coord/coord.sqlite"),"list","--prefix","run/"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
print("in the root clone store:",has("clone"),"| in the cwd clone store:",has("other"))
sys.exit(0 if has("clone") and not has("other") else 1)
